_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 48: CE marking
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity.
basis: EU AI Act Article 16(h) -- provider obligation to affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 48
EU AI Act Article 43 -- conformity assessment procedures
_metadata.awaiting_standard: Art. 48 refers to the general principles of the CE marking in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008; it names no harmonised standard.

requirements.title: CE Marking Affixed
requirements.requirement: The CE marking MUST be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly for the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the system, to the packaging or to the accompanying documentation, as appropriate.
requirements.rationale: Art. 48(3) sets how and where the CE marking is affixed.
acceptable_locations: The packaging, where affixing to the system is not possible or not warranted on account of its nature
The accompanying documentation, where affixing to the system is not possible or not warranted on account of its nature

requirements.title: Digital CE Marking for Systems Provided Digitally
requirements.requirement: For a high-risk AI system provided digitally, a digital CE marking MUST be used, only if it can easily be accessed via the interface from which the system is accessed or via an easily accessible machine-readable code or other electronic means (Article 48(2)). The digital CE marking is therefore to be made easily accessible by one of those means.
requirements.rationale: Art. 48(2) sets the form of the CE marking for systems provided digitally.
requirements.applies_when: The high-risk AI system is provided digitally.

requirements.title: Notified Body Identification Number
requirements.requirement: Where a notified body is responsible for the conformity assessment procedure set out in Article 43, the CE marking MUST be followed by the identification number of that notified body.
requirements.applies_when: A notified body is responsible for the conformity assessment procedure set out in Article 43.

requirements.title: Who Affixes the Identification Number
requirements.requirement: The identification number of the notified body MUST be affixed by a permitted performer: the notified body itself, or, under the notified body's instructions, the provider or the provider's authorised representative.
requirements.rationale: Art. 48(4), second sentence. The provider is responsible via Article 16(h); it does not have to affix the number itself.
requirements.applies_when: A notified body is responsible for the conformity assessment procedure set out in Article 43.

requirements.title: Identification Number in Promotional Material
requirements.requirement: Any promotional material which mentions that the high-risk AI system fulfils the requirements for CE marking MUST also indicate the identification number of the notified body.
requirements.applies_when: A notified body is responsible for the conformity assessment procedure set out in Article 43 and promotional material exists which mentions that the high-risk AI system fulfils the requirements for CE marking.

requirements.title: General Principles of the CE Marking
requirements.requirement: The CE marking MUST follow the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.
requirements.rationale: Art. 48(1) makes the CE marking subject to those principles. Human review against that Regulation is required.

requirements.title: CE Marking Under Other Union Law
requirements.requirement: Where the high-risk AI system is subject to other Union law which also provides for the affixing of the CE marking, the CE marking MUST indicate that the system also fulfils the requirements of that other law.
requirements.rationale: Art. 48(5). Human review of the other applicable Union law is required.
requirements.applies_when: The high-risk AI system is subject to other Union law which also provides for the affixing of the CE marking.

scoring.compliant: R01 met, and R02 to R07 met where they apply, confirmed by human review
scoring.partial: A CE marking is present but one or more applicable requirements are not confirmed
scoring.non_compliant: No CE marking, or an applicable requirement is not met
